obfuscation_indicators: if no mitigation steps are taken
risk_summary: The disclosure provides useful quantified sales and customer-concentration data, but relies heavily on broad forward-looking caveats and conditional language regarding tariffs, COVID-19, supply-chain disruption, and demand. Risk exposure is meaningful due to 90.5% sales concentration in three customers, sole manufacturing reliance on China, rising freight and component costs, and limited ability to quantify potential tariff impacts.
